sources: Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) Barista Skills Standards
rules: Always purge steam wand before and after steaming
Steam milk to 60-65°C (140-150°F); never exceed 70°C to avoid scorching
Confirm alternative milks or decaf substitutions before preparing
assumptions: Commercial dual-boiler espresso machine, calibrated conical grinder, fresh dairy and plant milks

levels.title: Milk Steaming & Microfoam Texturing
levels.skill_name: Steam milk to optimal silky microfoam
levels.goal: Steam whole milk to 60–65°C with glossy microfoam suitable for latte art
levels.description: Master aeration, whirlpool vortex texturing, and precise thermal cutoff to create silky microfoam without large bubbles.
customerProfiles: Flat white enthusiast who inspects foam density and temperature
successConditions: Milk temperature finishes strictly between 60°C and 65°C
Velvety wet-paint microfoam texture with zero large bubbles
Steam wand wiped and purged immediately after steaming
steps: Purge steam wand for 1 second over drip tray to clear condensation
Submerge wand tip 1cm below surface and tilt pitcher 15 degrees to establish whirlpool
Open steam valve fully; introduce air gently until pitcher reaches body temp (37°C)
Submerge wand slightly deeper to incorporate microfoam in a silent rolling vortex
Shut off steam valve as thermometer passes 60°C so thermal momentum settles at 62-65°C
Wipe wand thoroughly with damp cloth and purge steam immediately

levels.title: Dial in Espresso Extraction
levels.skill_name: Calibrate grind size, dose, and extraction ratio
levels.goal: Extract a 1:2 ratio espresso (18g in, 36g out) in 27–30 seconds with rich crema
levels.description: Adjust grind setting and distribution to eliminate channeling, achieving balanced sweetness and acidity.
customerProfiles: Espresso purist sensitive to under-extracted sourness or over-extracted bitterness
successConditions: Thick hazelnut crema without pale blonding or channeling
steps: Dose exactly 18.0g of coffee beans and grind into dry portafilter basket
Use WDT needle tool or tap to distribute grounds evenly without clumps
Tamp firmly and level with 15kg pressure
Flush group head for 2 seconds to stabilize brew temperature at 93°C
Insert and lock portafilter; immediately tare cup and scale under spouts
Engage 9-bar brew pump and stop shot at 36g yield (target: 28 seconds)

levels.title: Handle Milk Stockout & Order Substitution
levels.skill_name: Resolve unavailable supplies with clear customer communication
levels.goal: Politely resolve an oat milk latte order when oat milk is out of stock without delaying queue
levels.description: Check inventory, communicate shortage courteously, present delicious alternatives (almond/soy/dairy), and confirm choice before preparing.
customerProfiles: Busy morning commuter with dietary preference willing to accept alternative if offered kindly
successConditions: Customer explicitly confirms acceptable alternative or cancellation
steps: Check milk fridge and verify oat milk supply is at 0 cartons
Politely notify customer: 'I apologize, we are out of oat milk this morning'
Offer immediate alternatives: 'We have fresh almond milk or organic soy which pair great with this roast'
Wait for customer agreement before steaming
Prepare selected alternative and serve with a warm smile and discount token

levels.title: Multi-Order Barista Rush Prioritization
levels.skill_name: Parallel workflow and ticket sequencing during peak morning rush
levels.goal: Queue and prepare 3 concurrent espresso drinks in under 120 seconds while maintaining standards
levels.description: Interleave grinding, milk steaming, and espresso extraction so that milk and espresso finish simultaneously for each cup.
customerProfiles: Queue of 3 office workers ordering Americano, Latte, and Cortado
successConditions: All 3 drinks served at peak temperature within 120 seconds
Zero cross-contamination between dairy and allergen pitchers
Bar station maintained clean and wiped between tickets
steps: Review ticket sequence: Americano (hot water first), then Cortado, then Latte
Dose and lock espresso for drink 1; while shot extracts, steam milk for drink 2
Pour drink 1, rinse pitcher immediately, and stage cup 2
Grind dose 2, start extraction, and steam milk for drink 3
Serve all completed drinks and wipe steam wand and prep counter
checks: All drinks served hot and fresh
